svg.text: Legal bases · approximate counts (2025 band) · flagship project overlays

g.text: National Parks — WPA 1972 §35
~107 parks · strict inviolate core · no grazing; e.g., Jim Corbett (1936, first as Hailey NP), Kaziranga
Wildlife Sanctuaries — WPA §18/26A
~570+ · rights-continuum allowed to be settled · flexing protection norms
Conservation Reserves — WPA §36A
community/state partnerships; buffer connectors (corridor logic)
Community Reserves — WPA §36C
private/community lands with voluntary conservation; e.g., Kokkarebellur, Melkote
Tiger Reserves — WPA §38V (Project Tiger 1973)
57+ reserves · latest: Ratapani · Guru Ghasidas–Tamor Pingla (2024 cohort)
NTCA statutory oversight; core-buffer strategy; Tiger census 2022 = 3,682
Ramsar Wetlands — 80+ sites
1971 Convention; Montreux Record; additions each Feb 2
e.g., Chilika (1981), Keoladeo (1981), Sundarbans (2019), Sambhar/Asthamudi clusters
Biosphere Reserves — 18 (MAB programme)
Nilgiri (1986 first) · Nanda Devi · Sunderbans · Panna (2020)
World Network list: 12 of 18 registered incl. Gulf of Mannar, Khangchendzonga
Project Elephant (1992) & Corridors
33 elephant reserves · 132 corridors listed (2010); updates rolling
Synchronised census (2023–25) band ~27–30k; elephant = Schedule I WPA
Species focal missions
Cheetah Action Plan (Kuno 2022 → Gandhi Sagar phasing)
Snow Leopard SPAI estimate ~718 (2024) · Great Indian Bustard (GIB) captive
breeding in Rajasthan · Project Hangul (Dachigam)

svg.text: Counts are time-stamped bands — verify latest MoEFCC/NTCA/WII releases before quoting in exam.
